meta.name: security-secrets
meta.description: Use for secret management, IAM and RBAC hardening, Vault, KMS, SOPS, Sealed Secrets, CI secrets, workload identity, supply chain security, scanning, SBOM, signing, policy gates, audit, access review, and rotation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理密钥、加固访问权限并审计安全配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你负责密钥管理与权限安全
copy.tagline_en: Manage secrets, harden access, and audit security config.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for secrets and access security.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先阅读工作流程文档,分析密钥从存储到使用的完整路径,设计最小权限的访问策略,选择密钥管理方案,并加入扫描、策略、签名与审计门禁,最后验证访问、审计与轮换是否可行。
howto.when: 当用户提到密钥管理、IAM/RBAC 加固、Vault/KMS 等安全相关话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我把应用中的 Secrets 迁移到 Sealed Secrets
say.note: 会先绘制密钥流再给出迁移计划。

say.text: 审查一下 CI 流水线里有没有明文密钥
say.note: 会检查 CI 配置并指出密钥暴露风险。

say.text: 为 AWS 服务配置 workload identity 以取代静态密钥
say.note: 会按最小权限原则设计身份与访问策略。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first reads the workflow reference, maps the full path of secrets from storage to consumption, designs least-privilege access, chooses a secret management approach, adds scanning, policy, signing and audit gates, then validates access, audit and rotation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions secret management, IAM/RBAC hardening, Vault/KMS, or similar security-related topics from the skill description.

say_en.text: Help me migrate the app's Secrets to Sealed Secrets
say_en.note: It will map the secret flow before proposing a migration plan.

say_en.text: Review the CI pipeline for plaintext secrets
say_en.note: It will inspect CI config and flag exposed keys.

say_en.text: Set up workload identity for AWS services instead of static keys
say_en.note: It will design identity and access using least privilege.
